changes: Added the ability to merge explicitly selected EPG guide sources while preserving existing guide history.
Added support for downloading selected VOD items from M3U imports directly into a server folder.
Added a login screen selector with Simple and original Sci-Fi designs.
Improved login screen styling, preference synchronization, and input field focus behavior.
Hardened fanout_sync startup, streaming mode transitions, and automatic recovery through cron:servers after database outages.
Fixed stream relocation to allow offline source servers.
Improved cluster connection lifecycle management with atomic retirement operations and protection against stale connection events.
Improved cleanup of expired connections and dead worker registry entries.
Serialized and deduplicated cluster snapshot retry feedback to prevent redundant processing.
Prevented repeated ineffective connection snapshots and bounded cursor processing during continuous connection activity.
Improved connection retirement delivery and retained acknowledged retirement records for 24 hours before cleanup.
Stabilized replicated gateway policy ETags to avoid unnecessary configuration updates.
Improved EPG merge reliability and preservation of historical guide data.
Expanded TMDb genre mapping to cover all supported genre categories.
Hardened VOD import security, quota enforcement, and recovery behavior.
Improved VOD download worker execution through the process runner.
Fixed initial setup header rendering before the first administrator account exists.
Improved validation and error handling for malformed package group assignments in user and reseller operations.
Excluded transient cluster audit and retirement data from database backups.
Improved cluster recovery instructions with the relevant bundle path.
Updated Composer, Playwright, dotenv, and GitHub Actions dependencies.
Expanded initial setup regression tests and resolved source formatting violations.
